y-m-52-04.title: Idan ba mu san k ba, sau nawa jadawalin zai haɗu da axis x?
y-m-52-04.topic: Maki haɗuwar jadawalin aikin murabba’i da axis x
y-m-52-04.goal: Ka ga yadda hukunci kan yawan maki haɗuwar aikin murabba’i da axis x ke ƙuntatawa yayin da bayanai ke ƙaruwa, sannan ka jera duk shari’o’in da za su yiwu ko da ba a san wata ƙima ba.
y-m-52-04.material: Akwai parabola y=x²−4x+k (k ƙima ce ta dindindin). Ana bayyana bayanin k ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci, zaɓi abin da za ka iya faɗa game da yawan maki haɗuwar parabola da axis x (ka ƙirga maki da ya taɓa axis a matsayin maki 1).
y-m-52-04.thinking.0: La’akari da duk shari’o’in da za su yiwu idan bayanai ba su wadatar ba
y-m-52-04.thinking.1: Ƙuntata ko sauya hukunci bisa sabon bayani
y-m-52-04.thinking.2: Nemo ƙimomi da dama da suka cika sharadi
y-m-52-04.prereq.1: Jadawalin ayyukan murabba’i (kolo, buɗewa sama), da alaƙar tushen gaske na ma’aunin murabba’i da maki haɗuwar jadawali da axis x
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.0: A kowane mataki, bayyana da kalmomi inda kolo yake dangane da axis x (sama ko ƙasa).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.hint.1: Saka wasu ƙananan lambobi cikakku a madadin k, sannan ka tsara yawan maki haɗuwa a tebur.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.info: Ba ka san k ba, amma ka san kawai cewa k tabbatacciya ce (k>0).
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za mu iya faɗa game da yawan maki haɗuwar wannan parabola da axis x?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.after: Tunda y=(x−2)²+k−4 ne, kolo (2, k−4) ne. Idan 0<k<4 ne, kolo yana ƙasa da axis x, saboda haka maki 2 ne; idan k=4 ne, yana taɓa axis, saboda haka maki 1; idan k>4 ne, yana sama da axis, saboda haka maki 0 ne. Idan akwai ƙimar da ba a sani ba, dole a duba duk shari’o’in da za su iya faruwa. Shari’ar ƙima 0 ma tana yiwuwa idan an ƙayyade k=0.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Tunda k tabbatacciya ce, kolo yana sama da axis x; saboda haka maki haɗuwa 0 ne koyaushe.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Rubuta koòrdinatin y na kolo kai tsaye da k. “k tabbatacciya ce” ba daidai yake da “koòrdinatin y na kolo tabbatacciya ce” ba.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Parabola mai buɗewa sama tana da maki haɗuwa 2 koyaushe.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ko tana buɗewa sama, idan parabola tana sama da axis x gaba ɗaya, ba za ta haɗu da shi ba. Ka yi tunani kan matsayin kolo.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Gwargwadon ƙimar k, duka maki 0, 1, da 2 suna yiwuwa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya yi la’akari da shari’o’in yiwuwa ta hanyar tunanin koòrdinatin y na kolo yana motsawa sama da ƙasa tare da k.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Maki 0 ko 2 ne kaɗai za su yiwu, babu k da zai ba da maki 1 daidai.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Maki 1 yana faruwa idan kolo yana kan axis x. Duba ko irin wannan k yana cikin lambobin masu kyau.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.info: Sabon bayani: koòrdinatin y na kolo na wannan parabola bai wuce 0 ba.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.ask: Idan aka haɗa da bayanin k>0, me za mu iya faɗa game da yawan maki haɗuwa?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan k−4≤0 kuma k>0, to 0<k≤4. Idan 0<k<4 akwai maki daban-daban biyu; idan k=4 yana taɓawa a maki ɗaya. Saboda haka maki 0 ba zai yiwu ba, amma har yanzu ba mu san ko maki 1 ne ko 2 ba. Hukuncin farko (“duk suna yiwuwa”) bai yi kuskure ba; yayin da bayanai suka ƙaru, shari’o’in da za su yiwu sun ragu.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Yana haɗuwa a maki 1 ko 2 gwargwadon ko k=4 ne, kuma yana da aƙalla maki guda na haɗuwa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da ya bambance shari’ar da koòrdinatin y na kolo take 0 daga wadda take ƙasa da 0.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Ko da matsayin kolo ya yaya, maki 0, 1, da 2 duka har yanzu suna yiwuwa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Sake rubuta yadda sharadin cewa koòrdinatin y na kolo, k−4, bai wuce 0 ba ya ƙuntata zangon k da zai yiwu.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Idan ba mu san ko k daidai yake da 4 ba, ba za mu iya tantance ko maki 1 ne ko 2 ba; amma ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya bambance abin da ba za a iya tantancewa ba da abin da za a iya tantancewa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Tunda kolo yana ƙasa da axis x, maki 2 ne koyaushe.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Duba ko sharadin ya haɗa yanayin da koòrdinatin y na kolo yake daidai da 0.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.info: An kuma koya cewa k lamba cikakkiya ce. (k lamba cikakkiya ce da 0<k≤4.)
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ƙimomin k nawa ne suke sa koòrdinatin x na duk maki haɗuwar da axis x ya zama lambobi cikakku?
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan k=1, x=2±√3; idan k=2, x=2±√2, ba lambobi cikakku ba ne. Idan k=3, x=1, 3; idan k=4, x=2 (maki mai taɓawa), duka lambobi cikakku ne, saboda haka amsar 2 ce. Bisa ko an ƙirga yanayin taɓawa a matsayin maki haɗuwa, ana iya karanta amsar 1; saboda haka tun farko mun yarda cewa “a ƙirga shi a matsayin maki haɗuwa 1”.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Yanayin taɓawa (maki haɗuwa 1) ma maki haɗuwa ne. Ka sake duba ko ka bincika ko koòrdinatin x a wannan yanayin lamba cikakkiya ce.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne da ya dace da sakamakon saka ƙimomi huɗu na k ɗaya bayan ɗaya da nemo koòrdinatin maki haɗuwa.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Nemo kai tsaye koòrdinatin x na maki haɗuwa idan k=1 da k=2.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Nemo kai tsaye koòrdinatin x na maki haɗuwar axis x idan k=1, sannan ka duba ko lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-52-04.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ka yanke cewa “duk suna yiwuwa”, amma yayin da bayanai suka ƙaru, hukuncin ya takaita zuwa “ba 0 ba” da “2 ne kawai ke iya yiwuwa”. Ta yaya sauyin hukuncinka ya bambanta da kasancewar hukuncin farko kuskure? Idan da ka tsai da lamba guda ɗaya da bayanai kaɗan, a ina za ka yi kuskure?
y-m-52-04.s.s2.prompt: A wannan karon babu sharadin k ya zama tabbatacciya; kawai an ce lamba cikakkiya ce. Nemo ƙimomin k guda 3 daban-daban inda parabola ke haɗuwa da axis x a maki biyu daban-daban, kuma tazarar tsakaninsu lamba cikakkiya ce.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.0: Kayyade k guda ɗaya, sannan ka nemo koòrdinatin x na maki haɗuwa biyun.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta tazara tsakanin maki haɗuwa biyun da k, sannan ka binciki irin sigar da k dole ya kasance domin wannan ƙimar ta zama lamba cikakkiya.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Shigar da k a matsayin lamba cikakkiya.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.ok.c2: Yana haɗuwa a maki biyu daban-daban.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c2: Ba ya haɗuwa a maki biyu daban-daban ga wannan k. Duba ko kolo yana ƙasa da axis x.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Tazara tsakanin maki haɗuwa biyun lamba cikakkiya ce.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Tazara tsakanin maki haɗuwa biyun ba lamba cikakkiya ba ce. Nemo koòrdinatin x na maki biyun sannan ka duba bambancinsu.
y-m-52-04.s.s2.explain: Koòrdinatin x na maki haɗuwa biyun su ne 2±√(4−k), saboda haka tazarar ita ce 2√(4−k). Idan 4−k cikakkiyar murabba’i ce (1, 4, 9, 16, ...), tazarar lamba cikakkiya ce, kuma k=3, 0, −5, −12, −21, ...

y-m-52-01.title: Shin sakamakon daya ne idan muka musanya oda?
y-m-52-01.goal: Koyi cewa samun sakamako iri ɗaya don shigarwa ɗaya ba hujja ba ce don 'koyaushe iri ɗaya', kuma karyata da'awar ta hanyar nemo abubuwan da aka shigar inda odar ta canza sakamakon.
y-m-52-01.material:
Akwai injunan lissafin guda biyu. Na'ura f yana ninka shigarwar kuma yana ƙara 1 (f(x)=2x+1), kuma inji g yana yin murabba'in shigarwar (g(x)=x²). Shigar na iya zama kowace lamba ta gaske.
Idan kun haɗa su azaman 'f to g,' sakamakon shine g(f(x)); idan kun haɗa su a matsayin 'g to f,' sakamakon shine f(g(x)). Minseo ya ce, "Ga kowane na'ura guda biyu, sakamakon daya ne ko da kun canza tsari. Yana aiki don injinmu ma idan na saka 0. f to g: f (0) = 1, g (1) = 1. g sai f: g (0) = 0, f(0) = 1."

y-m-52-01.thinking.2: Faɗa abubuwan shigarwa na musamman inda maganganun biyu suka kasance daidai

y-m-52-01.s.s1.prompt: Minseo ya duba cewa duka umarni suna ba da 1 don shigarwar 0. Me za mu iya cewa daga wannan cak?

y-m-52-01.s.s1.hint.1: Duba a cikin tebur don koda tantanin halitta ɗaya inda sakamakon biyu ya bambanta.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.a: Daidai ne a 0, amma ba mu sani ba ko iri ɗaya ne ga sauran abubuwan shigarwa. Muna buƙatar canza shigarwar kuma mu lissafta daban.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne wanda ya san sakamakon shigarwa ɗaya ya gaya mana game da wannan shigarwar kawai, kuma wanda ke ƙoƙarin zaɓar ƙarin abubuwan shigar don gwadawa.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.b: Ƙirƙirar abu ne mai haɗawa kamar ninkawa, don haka daidai yake ko da an canza tsari, kuma kasancewa ɗaya a 0 shine shaida.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.b: Ba kamar ninkawa ba, canza tsari na abun da ke ciki yakan canza sakamakon. Bincika ko kasancewa ɗaya a 0 yana zama shaida, kuma ko iri ɗaya ne ga sauran abubuwan shigar kuma.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.c: Idan muka sanya wasu ƴan bayanai kuma duk sun fito iri ɗaya, to za mu iya cewa koyaushe suna ɗaya.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.c: Ko da kun duba wasu ƴan bayanai, ba ku duba duk ainihin lambobi ba. Don kammala su ɗaya ne, dole ne ku kwatanta maganganun, kuma kasancewa daban-daban za a iya nuna su ta hanyar misali ɗaya.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.o.d: Sakamakon lissafin farko na umarni biyu sun bambanta, f(0) = 1 da g(0) = 0, don haka sakamakon ƙarshe ya bambanta koyaushe.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.r.d: Ko da sakamakon matakin farko ya bambanta, sakamakon ƙarshe na iya zama iri ɗaya. A 0, sakamakon ƙarshe na umarni biyu sun kasance 1.
y-m-52-01.s.s1.explain: Daidaita a shigarwa ɗaya yana nufin sun dace da wannan shigarwar kawai. Don dubawa ko karya 'kullum,' kuna buƙatar gwada wasu abubuwan shigar kuma.
y-m-52-01.s.s2.prompt: Nemo bayanai daban-daban guda 3 x waɗanda suka karya da'awar Minseo. (Sakamako biyu g(f(x)) da f(g(x)) dole ne su bambanta. Kuna iya amfani da kowace lamba ta gaske x.)

y-m-52-02.topic: Matsakaici na jadawali na ayyuka masu juzu'i
y-m-52-02.goal: Karyata, tare da misalan misalan, kuskuren gabaɗaya cewa gaskiyar' jadawali na aikin juzu'i yana da ma'ana game da y=x' yana nufin 'madaidaicin madaidaicin suma akan y=x,' kuma bayyana yanayin da ke ƙarƙashin misalan misalan ke faruwa.
y-m-52-02.material:
Lokacin da f⁻¹ aiki f⁻¹, jadawali biyu suna da daidaito game da layin y=x. Jiho ya ce, “Don haka wuraren da jadawali na f da f⁻¹ suke haduwa koyaushe suna kan layi y=x. Misali, idan f(x)=2x−3, to f⁻¹(x)=(x+3)/2 sai jadawali biyu suka hadu a (3,3), don haka daidai. f(x)=x³), da (1) da (1), da (1)
(Kawai la'akari da ayyuka da aka ayyana don duk ainihin lambobi x. Bari mu kira layin y=x 'axis of symmetry.') 0,0 1,1

y-m-52-03.s.s1.explain: A cikin layi na 2, an canza 3 / (x-1) zuwa 1 / (x-1) (an sauke 3). Layin 4 shine sakamakon amfani da waccan magana mara kyau, don haka y-intercept ɗin ya fito azaman 1. Sauya x=0 cikin ainihin kalmar yana bada (0+1)/(0−1)=-1.

y-m-52-05.title: A ina mafitar Doyun ta karkata?
y-m-52-05.topic: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar aikin murabba’i a tazara, da ƙa’ida
y-m-52-05.goal: Koyi cewa zato “mafi ƙarancin ƙimar aikin murabba’i a tazara yana faruwa a kolo” ba lallai ya tabbata ba; raba shari’o’i domin nemo ƙimar ƙa’ida, sannan ka tabbatar cewa ƙimar ta cika zato.
y-m-52-05.material:
Doyun ya warware wannan matsala. (a ƙima ce ta dindindin, x kuma lamba ce ta gaske inda 0≤x≤3.)
Matsala: Nemo ƙimar a da za ta sa mafi ƙarancin f(x)=x²−2ax a 0≤x≤3 ya zama −12.
Ga mafitar Doyun a ƙasa.
y-m-52-05.thinking.0: Nemo zato ɓoyayye a cikin mafita.
y-m-52-05.thinking.2: Tabbatar cewa ƙimar da aka samo ta dace da zato.

y-m-52-05.prereq.2: Lissafi da furuci inda aka rubuta abin da ba a sani ba da harafin a.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a mafitar Doyun da ke da hukunci marar daidai. (Wataƙila akwai fiye da ɗaya.)
y-m-52-05.s.s1.hint.0: Duba da lambobi ko koòrdinatin x na kolo a yana cikin ko wajen tazara [0, 3].
y-m-52-05.s.s1.hint.1: Idan a=2√3, lissafta ƙimomin f(0) da f(3), sannan ka kwatanta su da −12.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.line.1: Mafi ƙarancin ƙima a tazara 0≤x≤3 ita ce −12, saboda haka −a²=−12 dole ya tabbata.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.line.3: Saboda haka ƙimomin a da suka cika sharadin su ne 2√3 da −2√3.
y-m-52-05.s.s1.explain: A layi na 2, an ɗauka cewa mafi ƙarancin ƙima tana faruwa a kolo, amma wannan gaskiya ce kawai idan koòrdinatin x na kolo, a, yana tsakanin 0 da 3 har da iyakoki. A layi na 4, ba a bincika ko a da aka samo tana cika wannan zato ba. 2√3≈3.46 da −2√3≈−3.46 duka suna wajen tazara [0,3].
y-m-52-05.s.s2.prompt: Muna son gyara mafitar Doyun. Idan a=5, menene mafi ƙarancin f(x)=x²−10x a tazara 0≤x≤3?

y-m-52-05.s.s2.hint.1: A cikin teburin, duba wane x ne ƙaramin ƙima ta bayyana.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.a: Wannan ita ce ƙimar da za a samu idan aka bar x² a gefe aka lissafta −10x kaɗai. Sake lissafa f(3) tun daga farko.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.b: An yi amfani da ƙimar kolo −a² yadda take. Da farko duba ko koòrdinatin x na kolo, 5, yana cikin tazara.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne da ya nemo maki a cikin tazara inda ƙima ta fi ƙanƙanta, sannan ya samo ƙimar f a wurin.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.r.d: Wannan ita ce ƙimar idan x=0. Kwatanta wane daga ƙarshen tazarar biyu ne ke ba da ƙima mafi ƙanƙanta.
y-m-52-05.s.s2.explain: Idan a=5, koòrdinatin x na kolo 5 yana wajen tazara. A cikin tazarar f tana ci gaba da raguwa, saboda haka ƙaramin ƙima yana x=3, kuma f(3)=9−30=−21.
y-m-52-05.s.s3.prompt: Yanzu nemo a daidai ka shigar da shi. (a da zai sa mafi ƙarancin f(x)=x²−2ax a tazara 0≤x≤3 ya zama daidai −12. Rubuta kaso a matsayin adadi mai digo.)
y-m-52-05.s.s3.hint.0: Raba zuwa shari’o’in a<0, a cikin tazara, da a>3; rubuta inda mafi ƙarancin ƙima ke faruwa a kowace shari’a.

y-m-52-06.title: Nawa ne curve da layi suke haɗuwa?
y-m-52-06.topic: Yawan maki haɗuwar jadawalin aikin rashin hankali da layi.
y-m-52-06.goal: Koyi cewa ba za a iya tantance yawan maki haɗuwar aikin rashin hankali da layi da discriminant na ma’aunin murabba’i kaɗai ba, sannan ka nemo da kanka zangon k da ke ba da haɗuwa 2 daidai ta la’akari da yankin aiki da zangon ƙimomi (x+k−1≥0).
y-m-52-06.material:
Jadawalin aikin rashin hankali y=√(x+2)+1 curve ne da ya fara a (−2, 1), ya hau sama-dama yana lafa a hankali (x≥−2). Muna son nemo yawan maki haɗuwarsa da layi y=x+k.
Daeun ta warware haka: “Daidaita furucin biyu don samun √(x+2)=x+k−1, sannan ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba’i don samun x²+(2k−3)x+(k−1)²−2=0. Discriminant na wannan ma’aunin murabba’i shi ne 13−4k; saboda haka idan k<13/4, akwai tushen gaske biyu daban, ma’ana maki haɗuwa biyu ne.”
y-m-52-06.thinking.1: Duba ko mafitar da aka samo ta cika asalin furuci.
y-m-52-06.thinking.2: Samar da ƙimomi da dama da suka cika sharadi.
y-m-52-06.prereq.1: Jadawalin aikin rashin hankali y=√(x+p)+q (yankin aiki, wurin farawa).
y-m-52-06.prereq.2: Tushen ma’aunin murabba’i da discriminant, da al’adar tabbatar da cewa tushen sun cika asalin furuci.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.prompt: Idan k=0, ma’aunin murabba’in Daeun shi ne x²−3x−1=0, tushensa biyun kusan 3.30 da −0.30 ne. Saka tushen biyun cikin asalin furuci √(x+2)=x−1. Wane hukunci za ka yanke game da maganar Daeun (maki haɗuwa biyu)?
y-m-52-06.s.s1.hint.0: Saka kowane tushen cikin √(x+2) da x−1, sannan ka rubuta ƙimomin biyun gefe da gefe.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko alamomin ƙimomin biyun iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.a: Ba daidai ba ne. Daga cikin tushen biyu, −0.30 yana sa gefen dama na asalin furuci ya zama mara kyau, saboda haka bai cika shi ba; maki haɗuwa guda ɗaya ne.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da ya saka tushen cikin asalin furuci, sannan ya duba har da alamomin ɓangarorin biyu.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.b: Daidai ne. Ma’aunin murabba’i yana da tushe biyu, kuma suna cikin yankin x≥−2; saboda haka maki haɗuwa biyu ne.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.b: Ka duba cewa tushen suna cikin yankin aiki kawai. Sake duba ko alamomin ɓangarorin asalin furuci sun dace.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.c: Ba daidai ba ne. Ma’aunin murabba’i ba shi da tushe, saboda haka maki haɗuwa 0 ne.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.c: Ma’aunin x²−3x−1=0 yana da tushen gaske. Tambayar ita ce ko tushen sun cika asalin furuci.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.o.d: Ba daidai ba ne, amma dalilin kuskuren yankin aiki ne. x=−0.30 yana da kyau domin x≥−2, saboda haka ɗaya daga cikin tushen lissafin ne ya yi kuskure.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.r.d: x=−0.30 yana cikin yankin aiki. Nemo wani dalili, sannan ka kwatanta sakamakon saka cikin asalin furuci.
y-m-52-06.s.s1.explain: √(x+2) ba ta da ƙasa da 0, saboda haka x−1 ma dole ya zama ba ƙasa da 0 ba. Idan x=−0.30 ne, x−1=−1.30<0; saboda haka bai cika √(x+2)=x−1 ba (tushen ƙarya da aka samar yayin ɗaga ɓangarorin biyu murabba’i). Idan k=0, ainihin maki haɗuwa guda ɗaya kawai yana x≈3.30.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin k guda 3 daban-daban da layi y=x+k da curve y=√(x+2)+1 suke haɗuwa a maki biyu daban-daban. (Za a iya shigar da adadi mai digo.)
y-m-52-06.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi wasu ƙimomin k ka kwatanta da kalmomi sifar curve da layin (ka yi tunanin matsar da layin sama da ƙasa).
y-m-52-06.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo k da zai sa layin ya wuce wurin farawa (−2,1) na curve.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.hint.2: Ƙidaya kai tsaye ka kwatanta yawan maki haɗuwa idan k=3 da k=2.9.
y-m-52-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Yawan maki haɗuwa ba 2 ba ne ga wannan k. Ka yi tunanin ko layin yana sama ko ƙasa da wurin farawa (−2,1) na curve, da kuma lokacin da taɓawa ke faruwa. (farawa a maki (−2, 1), kuma ba maki 2 ba ne a wannan k.)
y-m-52-06.s.s2.explain: Idan t=√(x+2) (t≥0), maki haɗuwar y=x+k da y=√(x+2)+1 sun yi daidai da tushen t≥0 na k=−t²+t+3, kowane tushe yana wakiltar maki guda. A t≥0, −t²+t+3 tana da ƙima 3 idan t=0 da matsakaicin 13/4 idan t=1/2; saboda haka idan 3≤k<13/4, maki haɗuwa 2 ne; idan k=13/4, yana taɓawa a maki 1; idan k<3, maki 1 ne; idan k>13/4, maki 0 ne. Misali idan k=3, suna haɗuwa a (−2,1) da (−1,2).
y-m-52-06.s.s3.prompt: Yayin da aka ɗaga layi y=x+k a hankali daga ƙasa mai nisa, akwai lokuta biyu da yawan maki haɗuwa ke sauyawa. Bayyana matsayin layi da curve a kowane lokaci.
y-m-52-06.s.s3.hint.0: Nemo k idan layin yana wucewa ta wurin farawa (−2,1).
y-m-52-06.s.s3.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin lokacin da, yayin ƙarin ɗaga layin, yake taɓa curve kaɗan-kaɗan.
y-m-52-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka bayyana matsayin layi da curve da kalmomi a lokutan biyun?
y-m-52-06.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka danganta su da ƙimomin k (3, 13/4)?
y-m-52-06.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ka kwatanta yawan maki haɗuwa kafin da bayan kowane lokaci?
y-m-52-06.s.s3.model.0: Yayin ɗaga layin, da farko idan ya wuce wurin farawa (−2,1) na curve (k=3), maki haɗuwa yana ƙaruwa daga 1 zuwa 2. Idan aka ƙara ɗaga shi, a lokacin da ya taɓa curve (k=13/4) sai ya zama 1, bayan haka kuma ya zama 0.
y-m-52-06.s.s3.model.1: Da farko yana haɗuwa da curve a maki ɗaya; idan layin ya wuce ƙarshen hagu, sai maki biyu su samu. Yayin da yake ƙara hawa, a wani lokaci yana shafawa curve sau ɗaya, ya wuce, ba sa sake haɗuwa.
y-m-52-06.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa da ta yi bayani da matsayin abubuwa ba tare da lambobi ba
y-m-52-06.s.s3.model.2: Adadin haɗuwa yana canzawa a k=3 da k=13/4. A k=3 yana ratsa wurin farawa, a k=13/4 kuma suna haɗuwa a maki guda.
y-m-52-06.s.s3.modelNote.2: Amsa ce da ta ambaci lokutan biyun ta ƙimar k.

y-m-52-08.title: Nawa ne ke sa ƙimomin su tashi?
y-m-52-08.topic: Ƙirga ayyuka da haɗin kai-da-kai da suka cika sharadi.
y-m-52-08.goal: Ƙirƙiri ayyuka da suka cika “f(1)<f(2)<f(3)” da kanka, ka kwatanta hanyoyin ƙirga daban-dabam, sannan ka yanke hukunci yadda sharadin ke canza adadi.
y-m-52-08.material: Muna son ƙirga ayyukan f daga X={1, 2, 3} zuwa Y={1, 2, 3, 4, 5} da suka cika f(1)<f(2)<f(3). (f(1), f(2), f(3) kowanne kashi ne na Y.)
y-m-52-08.thinking.0: Kwatanta ko hanyoyin ƙirga daidai ne.
y-m-52-08.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri haɗin kai-da-kai da ya cika sharadin da kanka.
y-m-52-08.thinking.2: Hasashen yadda ƙirga ke canzawa idan sharadi ya yi laushi.
y-m-52-08.prereq.1: Ma’anar aiki (kowane kashi a yankin tushe yana da daidai kashi guda a yankin amsa).
y-m-52-08.prereq.2: Ka’idar ninkawa da tunanin asali na permutatu da haɗawa.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.prompt: Abokai huɗu sun ƙirga ta hanyoyi dabam-dabam. Zaɓi duk hanyoyin da suka yi daidai.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi kashi 3 na Y ka jero duk f da za a iya yi da ƙimomin.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.hint.1: Yi amfani da {1,2,3} misali ka kwatanta hanyar Seoyun da sharadin f(1)<f(2)<f(3).
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.a: Hajun: Ana iya zaɓar f(1), f(2), f(3) kowanne ta hanya 5, saboda haka 5×5×5=125.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.a: 125 adadin duk ayyuka ne ba tare da sharadi ba. Yi tunani yadda sharadin f(1)<f(2)<f(3) ke rage adadin.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.b: Seoyun: f(1) yana da zaɓi 5, f(2) zaɓi 4 cikin sauran, f(3) zaɓi 3, saboda haka 5×4×3=60.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.b: 5×4×3 adadin jera ƙimomi uku dabam-dabam ne. Yi tunani cikin jeri nawa na waɗannan ƙimomi ne sharadin ke cika.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.c: Jihu: Idan aka zaɓi ƙimomi uku dabam-dabam, ana ware su a matsayin f(1), f(2), f(3) daga ƙarami, saboda haka 10.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.c: Wannan hukunci ya yi la’akari da ko zaɓar ƙimomi uku dabam-dabam yana kayyade jeri guda tak da ya cika sharadin.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.o.d: Naeun: Cikin 60 na Seoyun, jeri guda 1 ne kawai cikin jerin 6 na ƙimomi uku yake ƙaruwa, saboda haka 60÷6=10.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci ya danganta adadin jerin ƙimomi uku dabam-dabam da kaso mai cika sharadin.
y-m-52-08.s.s1.explain: Idan aka zaɓi ƙimomi uku dabam-dabam {p<q<r}, ana kayyade aiki mai ƙaruwa guda f(1)=p, f(2)=q, f(3)=r; wannan haɗin kai-da-kai ne da duk ayyukan da ke ƙaruwa. Saboda haka 5C3=10. 60 na Seoyun yana ƙirga kowace jeri na ƙimomi uku sau 6, don haka 60÷6=10 ma yana ba da amsa.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.prompt: Gina ayyuka da suka cika f(1)<f(2)<f(3) a matsayin ukun da aka jera (f(1),f(2),f(3)) guda 4 dabam-dabam. (a=f(1), b=f(2), c=f(3), duk cikakkun lambobi daga 1 zuwa 5.)
y-m-52-08.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko yanke mafi ƙarancin ƙimar f(1), sannan jero ƙimomin da f(2) da f(3) za su iya ɗauka.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.hint.1: Ƙara su cikin jerinka ɗaya bayan ɗaya ta yadda ba za su maimaita ukun da ka riga ka ƙirƙira ba.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.fail.c1: Shigar da ƙimomi ukun duka a matsayin cikakkun lambobi.
y-m-52-08.s.s2.fail.c2: Za ka iya amfani da abubuwan Y={1,2,3,4,5} kawai. [lambobi: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
y-m-52-08.s.s2.fail.c3: Ƙimomin ba su cikin jere mai ƙaruwa ba. Sake zaɓa ta yadda f(1)<f(2)<f(3).
y-m-52-08.s.s3.prompt: Idan muka sauya sharadi zuwa f(1)≤f(2)≤f(3), adadin ayyukan da suka cika zai fi 10, ya gaza ko ya yi daidai? Ka bayyana dalili da misali.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta aiki guda da ke cika sabon sharadi amma ba na baya ba.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.hint.1: Duba ko ayyukan da suka cika tsohon sharadi suna cika sabon ma.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta misalin aiki da aka yarda da shi yanzu amma ba a baya?
y-m-52-08.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka ce duka 10 na baya har yanzu suna ciki?
y-m-52-08.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ko ba tare da ƙirga ƙarin adadin daidai ba, ka bayyana da kalmomi dalilin da ya sa adadin ya ƙaru?
y-m-52-08.s.s3.model.0: Yana ƙaruwa. Tunda ƙimomi iri ɗaya sun halatta, kamar f(1)=f(2), sabbin yanayi kamar (1,1,2) ko (2,2,2) sun bayyana, kuma tsoffin 10 duk suna nan.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.model.1: Ya fi girma. Tunda ƙimomi na iya zama ɗaya, (3,3,5) da (4,4,4) suna yiwuwa. Tsofaffin 10 masu f(1)<f(2)<f(3) duk suna cika sabon sharadi ma, saboda haka ya fi 10.
y-m-52-08.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta nuna cewa tsoffin 10 suna ciki.

y-m-52-09.title: Idan samfura biyu sun ratsa maki iri ɗaya, wanne ya kamata mu amince da shi?
y-m-52-09.topic: Kwatanta samfurin inverse proportion da samfurin layi.
y-m-52-09.goal: Da sabbin ma’auni mataki-mataki, yanke wanne daga samfura biyu da suka dace da maki biyu za a amince da shi, tare da la’akari da kewayon amfani da samfurin da kuskuren aunawa.
y-m-52-09.material: A kan wata hanya, an ɗauki minti 72 a gudun 10 km/h da minti 48 a gudun 15 km/h. Ba a rubuta ko tafiyar biyun sun bi hanya ɗaya ba. Sieun ta ba da layi madaidaiciya ta maki biyun a matsayin samfurin A (lokaci=120−4.8×gudu), Minjae kuma ya ba da inverse proportion a matsayin samfurin B (lokaci=720÷gudu). Samfuran biyun sun dace da ma’aunai biyun daidai. Gudun km/h ne, lokaci kuma minti.
y-m-52-09.thinking.1: Yanke kewayon da samfurin zai iya aiki.
y-m-52-09.thinking.2: Fassara bambanci tsakanin aunawa da hasashen.
y-m-52-09.prereq.1: Jadawali da furucin aikin layi da inverse proportion, dangantakar gudu, tazara da lokaci.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.prompt: Ana ƙara ma’aunai ɗaya bayan ɗaya. A kowane lokaci zaɓi samfurin da za a amince da shi da yadda za a yi.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.hint.0: Saka 20, 25 da 30 km/h cikin kowane samfurin, ka kwatanta ƙimomin da aka hasashe a tebur.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.hint.1: Lissafa bambanci tsakanin ƙimomin da aka hasashe da waɗanda aka auna, ka kwatanta samfuran.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.info: Bayanan da aka sani yanzu su ne ma’aunai biyu kawai (minti 72 a 10 km/h, minti 48 a 15 km/h).
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.ask: Idan gudu 20 km/h ne, mintuna nawa kake hasashen zai ɗauka?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.after: Samfurin A yana hasashen minti 24 a 20 km/h, B kuma minti 36. Idan tafiyar hanya ɗaya ce, gudu×lokaci (bayan daidaita raka’a) ya kamata ya zama tabbatacce, don haka B ya fi zama na halitta. Amma ba a tabbatar tafiya iri ɗaya ba, saboda haka yana da ma’ana a ce bayanin nan kaɗai bai isa yanke hukunci ba.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Hasashen samfuran biyun ya bambanta, don haka ba za mu iya yanke hukunci daga bayanin kaɗai ba. Muna buƙatar aunawa a 20 km/h.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Hukunci ne da ya amince cewa bayanin ba ya nuna wanne samfurin daidai ne, sannan ya yanke bayanin da za a tattara gaba.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Minti 24. Layi ta maki biyu shi ne samfurin mafi sauƙi, don haka mu amince da layin yadda yake.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Dacewa da maki biyu ba hujja ba ce cewa layin daidai ne. Idan tafiya hanya ɗaya ce, menene samfurin lokacin×gudu?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Minti 36. Idan tafiya hanya ɗaya ce, gudu×lokaci ya kamata ya zama tabbatacce.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hukunci ne da ya samo dangantakar gudu da lokaci daga zato cewa hanya ɗaya ce. Amma ba a tabbatar da wannan zaton ba tukuna.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Minti 30. Matsakaicin 24 da 36 yana da ƙaramin kuskure ko wanne ne ba daidai ba.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Matsakaicin samfuran biyun ƙima ce da babu samfurin da ya hasashe. Ƙimar tana danganta da samfurin da ka amince da shi.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.info: Idan aka saka 30 km/h cikin A, ana samun −24 minti; cikin B kuma minti 24.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.ask: Me za ka yanke game da samfurin A?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.after: A 25 km/h, lokacin A ya zama minti 0, sama da haka kuma mara kyau. Saboda haka A yana aiki ne kawai idan gudu bai wuce 25 ba. B yana ba da ƙima mai kyau ga duk gudu mai kyau, amma wannan ba hujja ba ce cewa B daidai ne; dole a tabbatar da sabon ma’auni.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.a: B ma yana da matsala cewa lokaci yana matsowa 0 yayin da gudu ke ƙaruwa, saboda haka samfuran biyun ba su dace daidai ba.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ko gudu ya yi girma nawa, lokacin B yana nan tabbatacce. Kwatanta ko matsalar ɗaya ce da A mai lokacin sifili ko mara kyau. [lambobi: 0]
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Lokaci mara kyau ba zai yiwu ba, saboda haka ba za a iya amfani da A idan gudu ya fi 25 km/h. Dole ne a takaita kewayon.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Hukunci ne da ya yi la’akari da kewayon da samfurin zai ba da ƙimomin zahiri.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.c: An tabbatar ne kawai cewa A ba zai iya aiki a wannan kewayon ba; ko B daidai ne dole a tabbatar da sabon ma’auni.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Hukunci ne da ya bambanta gano aibi da tabbatar da ɗayan samfurin daidai.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.o.d: An tabbatar da matsalar A, saboda haka a zahiri an riga an tabbatar da samfurin inverse proportion B daidai ne.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Aibi a samfurin ɗaya ba hujja ba ce cewa ɗayan daidai ne. Yi tunani ko akwai ɓangarorin B da ba a gwada ba tukuna.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.info: An tabbatar cewa tafiyar 20 km/h ta yi amfani da hanya ɗaya da tafiyoyin biyun baya. Ainihin tafiyar ta ɗauki minti 37 (ta jira fitilar titi sau ɗaya).
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.ask: Idan aka duba ma’aunin, me za ka yi game da samfurin B?
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.after: B ya yi hasashen minti 36, bambanci minti 1; A kuma bambanci minti 13 ne. Ƙaramin bambanci na iya bayyana saboda yanayin aunawa kamar jiran fitila, saboda haka yana da ma’ana a riƙe B. Duk da haka, sake aunawa a yanayi iri ɗaya zai ƙara tabbaci.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Bambancin minti 36 da 37 kaɗan ne, kuma ana iya bayyana shi da jiran fitila, saboda haka mu riƙe B tare da la’akari da kuskure.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Hukunci ne da ya duba girman bambanci, ya yi la’akari da wani abu wajen bayanai (jiran fitila), sannan ya riƙe samfurin.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.b: B ya hasashe minti 36 amma ainihin 37 ne, saboda haka samfurin ba daidai ba ne; a watsar da shi a ƙirƙiri wani.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Idan aka watsar da samfurin saboda hasashe da aunawa ba daidai suke ba, za a watsar da kusan kowane samfurin. Yi tunani kan girma da dalilin bambancin.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.c: A ya fi sauƙin furuci, kuma ya dace da ma’aunai biyun farko daidai, saboda haka a yi watsi da rashin daidaiton 37 a riƙe A.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Hasashen A minti 24 ne, ya bambanta da ainihin da minti 13. Yi tunani ko za a yi watsi da babban bambanci don furucin kawai ya fi sauƙi.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Bambanci tsakanin hasashe da aunawa ya fi ƙanƙanta ga B (minti 1 maimakon 13). Ana iya bincika tasirin jiran fitila da sake aunawa.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Hukunci ne da ya kwatanta girman bambancin da lambobi, sannan ya ba da shawarar ƙarin aunawa.
y-m-52-09.s.s1.reflect: Da farko yana da wuya a gane samfurin daidai, amma bayanai sun ƙaru, an takaita kewayon amfani da A, B kuma ya kusa aunawa. Duk lokacin da bayanai suka ƙaru, ta yaya ka bambanta “abin da aka tabbatar” da “abin da ba a tabbatar ba tukuna”?

y-m-52-10.title: Idan ba mu san a ba, akwai mafi girma?
y-m-52-10.topic: Samuwar mafi girman ƙima na aikin quadratic bisa parameter.
y-m-52-10.goal: Koyi cewa nau’in furuci na iya canzawa bisa ƙimar constant a da ba a sani ba; yanke bayanin da ake buƙata domin mafi girma ya wanzu, sannan nemo a da ya cika sharadin da kanka.
y-m-52-10.material: Akwai aiki f(x)=(a−1)x²+4x+1. a constant lambar ainihi ce, x kuma kowace lambar ainihi ce. Seunghun ya ce, “Tunda aikin quadratic ne, dole yana da ko mafi girma ko mafi ƙaranci”, amma har yanzu ba a san ƙimar a ba.
y-m-52-10.thinking.1: Duba dabam yanayin da nau’in furuci ke canzawa.
y-m-52-10.prereq.1: Mafi girma da ƙaranci na aikin quadratic (cika murabba’i), coefficient na x² da siffar jadawali.
y-m-52-10.prereq.2: Jadawalin ayyukan layi (yanayin da babu mafi girma ko ƙaranci).
y-m-52-10.s.s1.prompt: Wane bayani muke buƙata don yanke ko f yana da mafi girma (ga dukkan x na ainihi)?
y-m-52-10.s.s1.hint.0: Saka ƙimomi kamar 0,1,2 a matsayin a, rubuta f(x), ka bayyana siffar jadawali da kalmomi. [lambobi: 0, 1, 2]
y-m-52-10.s.s1.hint.1: Nemo a da ke sa coefficient na x² a furuci ya zama 0.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.a: Muna buƙatar sanin ko a tabbatacce ne ko mara kyau. Alamar ce ke yanke alkiblar lanƙwasar jadawali.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.a: Coefficient na x² ba a ba shi da a ba, a−1 ne. Sake rubuta wace ƙima ce ke yanke ko coefficient ɗin tabbatacce ne ko mara kyau.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.b: Ya isa haka. Tunda aikin quadratic ne, dole yana da mafi girma.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.b: Duba ko akwai a da ke sa coefficient a−1 ya zama 0. Wane irin aiki ne a wannan yanayin?
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.c: Muna buƙatar sanin kewayon x daga ina zuwa ina.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.c: An riga an bayar da kewayon x a matsalar (duk lambobin ainihi). Duba abin da ba a sani ba har yanzu.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.o.d: Muna buƙatar sanin ko a ya gaza, ya yi daidai, ko ya fi 1.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.r.d: Hukunci ne da ya yi la’akari da ko siffar jadawali tana rabuwa bisa alamar coefficient a−1 na x² da ko ya zama 0.
y-m-52-10.s.s1.explain: Idan a−1<0, aikin quadratic yana buɗe ƙasa, yana da mafi girma; idan a−1>0, yana buɗe sama, babu mafi girma (mafi ƙaranci kawai); idan a=1, f(x)=4x+1 aikin layi ne, babu mafi girma ko ƙaranci. Don haka muna buƙatar sanin matsayin a idan aka kwatanta da 1.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.prompt: Nemo ƙimomin a guda 3 dabam-dabam da f ke da mafi girma, kuma wannan mafi girman ƙima aƙalla 5 ce. (Za ka iya shigar da adadi goma.)
y-m-52-10.s.s2.hint.0: Saka a=0, a=0.5 da a=−1, nemo mafi girma ga kowanne, ka kwatanta.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.hint.1: Duba da wasu ƙimomi yadda mafi girma ke canzawa yayin da a ke matsowa kusa da 1.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.ok.c1: f aikin quadratic ne mai buɗe ƙasa (yana da mafi girma).
y-m-52-10.s.s2.fail.c1: Ga wannan a, f ba shi da mafi girma. Duba alamar coefficient na x² ko ya zama sifili. [lambobi: 0]
y-m-52-10.s.s2.fail.c2: Mafi girma ya gaza 5. Gwada ƙimomi kaɗan don ganin yadda mafi girma ke canzawa idan a ya canza.
y-m-52-10.s.s2.explain: Ga f(x)=(a−1)x²+4x+1, idan a<1 mafi girma shi ne 1−4/(a−1)=1+4/(1−a). Domin ya zama aƙalla 5, 4/(1−a)≥4, wato 0<1−a≤1, don haka 0≤a<1. Misali, idan a=0 mafi girma 5 ne; a=0.5 yana 9; a=0.9 yana 41.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.prompt: Bayyana dalilin da ya sa dole a duba yanayin a=1 dabam, sannan rubuta kewayon a da ke sa mafi girma aƙalla 5.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.hint.0: Saka a=1 cikin furuci ka rubuta f(x) a sauƙaƙe.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta da mafi girma idan a=0.5 ka nemo yadda a zai iya raguwa.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ka rubuta a sarari furuci da siffar jadawalin idan a=1?
y-m-52-10.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana ko iyakokin kewayon suna ciki ko a’a (0 ko fiye, ƙasa da 1)?
y-m-52-10.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Misalan a da ka samu suna cikin kewayon da ka rubuta?
y-m-52-10.s.s3.model.0: Idan a=1, coefficient na x² ya zama 0 kuma f(x)=4x+1 aiki ne na layi, saboda haka babu mafi girma. Kewayon a da mafi girma yake aƙalla 5 shi ne aƙalla 0 amma ƙasa da 1.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.model.1: Idan a=1, layi ne, yana ƙaruwa ba iyaka zuwa sama, babu mafi girma. Mafi girma 1+4/(1−a) ne, kuma domin ya zama aƙalla 5, a dole ya kasance aƙalla 0 kuma ƙasa da 1.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta rubuta furucin mafi girma.
y-m-52-10.s.s3.model.2: Idan a=1, f(x)=4x+1, saboda haka babu ƙimar mafi girma. Domin mafi girma ya zama aƙalla 5, ana buƙatar 0≤a<1.
